mapper.select: SELECT CAST(IFNULL(SUM(point), 0) AS SIGNED) monthpenalty FROM ttokssaemdb.blackmark WHERE memberid = #{memberid} AND branchid = #{branchid} AND cancelyn = 'N' AND regdate > LAST_DAY(NOW() - interval 1 month) AND regdate <= LAST_DAY(NOW())

SELECT CAST(IFNULL(SUM(point), 0) AS SIGNED) cumulativePenalty FROM ttokssaemdb.blackmark WHERE memberid = #{memberid} AND branchid = #{branchid} AND cancelyn = 'N' AND regdate > LAST_DAY(NOW() - interval 3 month) AND regdate <= LAST_DAY(NOW())

SELECT blackmarkid, blackmark, blackmarkname, point, reason, DATE_FORMAT(regdate, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') regdate, cancelyn, DATE_FORMAT(canceldate, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') canceldate FROM ttokssaemdb.blackmark WHERE memberid = #{memberid} AND branchid = #{branchid} ORDER BY regdate DESC, blackmarkid DESC LIMIT ${length} OFFSET ${start}
